notes.title: Unknowz Update - 1.0.3
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Unknowz!Here’s what’s new in this update:
General game optimization (around 1ms per frame gained, resulting in up to 10 additional FPS depending on your configuration).

notes.title: Update Unknowz - 1.0.2
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Unknowz! Here’s what’s new in this update:
Added explosion sound when kamikaze enemies die.

Removed an element that allowed players to skip the final shark puzzle without solving it.

Added audio feedback during the shark sequence.

The shark now resumes chasing players if you reload a game in the middle of its level.

Enemy damage is now displayed when they are hit.

General game optimization (textures, ticking actors, shadows, lights). Game size reduced by 300MB and stability improved.



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3826300/Unknowz/"][/dynamiclink]

notes.title: Minor Update Unknowz 1.0.1
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Unknowz!

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Set Sail, Crew!
notes.content:
The wait is over, Captain! 


After months of hard work, our pirate adventure is finally ready for all brave sailors out there and it’s LIVE on Steam!  


⚓ What awaits you:


A unique duo: a living pirate and his undead companion  

Endless waves of skeletons hungry for your bones  

Explosive action (in every sense of the word)  

An epic escape from the cursed island  


💡 Developed by a small student team in just 9 months 


This project was crafted with passion by a small crew of game design students, working side-by-side to bring this cursed island to life. Every detail, from the first line of code to the final explosion, was made with love (and a bit of rum).  


💬 Got feedback or facing an issue?


We’re here for you!  

If you encounter any bug, technical issue, or simply want to share your ideas, feel free to reach out to us through the Steam Community Hub or our contact channels.  

We love chatting with players and hearing your stories – every message helps us improve and make the game even better!  


⛵ Ready to set sail?


Download the game now and join the adventure!
